description: Toyota's Bridge specialist for the ChatGPT relay: lists the signed-in ChatGPT sessions, asks one of them something and waits for the finished reply, reads a thread, types or sends without doing both
notes: Toyota's profile maps this name to adapters/bridge_specialist_runner.BridgeSpecialistRunner. The model only picks the operation and the session name; bridge_client/relay_plans.py builds the exact JSON prompt. Every change is read back and sent only after a yes. The same Bridge agent, worker adapter and relay ADW (adws/adw_chatgpt_relay.py) that ChatGPT drives.
